title: Crypto Maker-First → Timeout → Market Fallback PAPER A/B Spec (X1)

executor.two_phase: SELL executors first, BUY after SELL terminal (preserves SELL-before-BUY)

maker_60s.description: Post-only limit at touch, timeout 60s, cancel→market fallback
maker_60s.limit_price: BUY: best_bid + offset, SELL: best_ask - offset (offset 0 = at touch)

randomization.method: uuid4 % 2 stratified by timestamp, persisted assignment for restart determinism

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: B realized taker-fee + slippage per dollar traded < A
predeclared_hypotheses.test: two-sided t-test p<0.05 (pilot estimation, not gating)
predeclared_hypotheses.note: All three hypotheses predeclared before PAPER start; no interim peeking

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: B final fill rate (delta fully filled within timeout+cancel+fallback ≤90s) ≥98% of A
no increase in ambiguous-order incidents vs A; idempotency duplicate count = 0; SELL-before-BUY violations = 0

sample_size_note: 96h cadence → ~3-4 rebalances per 14 days, 0-2 deltas each → 6-8 deltas total is underpowered; pilot is estimation+feasibility not powered efficacy gate. 30-day follow-up would be the gate.

operational_safeguards.config_change: no production config/settings.yaml values changed; new stanza defaults disabled
operational_safeguards.logging: executor transitions INFO, fills INFO, ambiguous WARNING+incident

promotion_rule: Promote B to default only if all four hypotheses hold + cancel succeeds within 5s ≥95% of timeouts. Requires docs/crypto_maker_pilot_verdict_*.md + operator approval. No silent promotion.
data_files_note: Backtest daily-bar files (equity_1200_2016_2026.csv, crypto_expanded_1h.csv) are explicitly NOT used to estimate maker fill probability
